title: Fix Hero 'Contact Sales' CTA button rendering as raw translation key

requirements.text: In the HeroSection component, fix the 'Contact Sales' CTA button so it renders as the human-readable label 'Contact Sales' (English), the correct Hindi translation, and the correct Marathi translation — instead of the raw translation key (e.g., 'Hero.ctaContactSale', 'Hero.ctacontact', or any similar raw key string). Ensure the translation key used in HeroSection's JSX exactly matches the key defined in frontend/src/translations/translations.ts for all three language codes (en, hi, mr), and that the translations.ts values for this key are plain human-readable strings (not raw JSON, escaped characters, or template literal artifacts). The button must display correctly in all three language modes.

quotes: Hero.ctacontact sale is not fixed still in technical text.

acceptanceCriteria: The 'Contact Sales' CTA button in HeroSection renders the human-readable label 'Contact Sales' when the language is set to English.
The button renders the correct Hindi translation when the language is set to Hindi — no raw key or artifact is visible.
The button renders the correct Marathi translation when the language is set to Marathi — no raw key or artifact is visible.
The translation key used in HeroSection JSX exactly matches the key present in translations.ts for all three language codes.
No raw translation key string (e.g., 'Hero.ctaContactSale', 'Hero.ctacontact', or similar) is ever visible on screen for this button.
No other HeroSection content, layout, or functionality is changed.

constraints: Do not modify any other section, component, or page beyond HeroSection and translations.ts.
Do not change the button's link target (it must continue to link to the #contact section).
The company name 'True Origin Company LLP' must remain untranslated in all language modes.
nonGoals: Redesigning or restyling the HeroSection component.
Fixing any other translation issues outside of the 'Contact Sales' CTA button key.
Changes to backend logic or data models.
